completion_data.completion_summary: specs/ROADMAP.md's ## Next and ## Open work now render wholly from new roadmap_batches/roadmap_notes state.json entries with no retention parser in the path; a new /roadmap [instruction] command/skill/judgment-bearing agent trio maintains those entries (entries via state-write.sh, edges via the existing edge_only arm, rendering via roadmap-integration.sh --regenerate); the live file's prior authored judgment was migrated into state via a one-time script with a hard losslessness accounting gate; and both /roadmap invocation forms were demonstrated end-to-end against this repository's live roadmap, each committed.

memory_candidates.content: When inverting a generated-artifact's retention model (moving authored judgment from parse-back-out-of-the-rendered-file into a structured state field), test the migration script against the REAL live document before trusting a hand-written fixture: a GFM 'tight' list (no blank line between consecutive bullet items, the common real-world markdown style) will silently merge an entire bullet list into one unsplit paragraph block under a naive 'blank-line-delimited paragraph' splitter, even though a deliberately blank-line-separated test fixture never exercises this. Fix: a block boundary must also fire at the START of a fresh top-level list-item line, not only at a blank line. Separately, when attributing a free-text block to an entity by 'first id token it names', scope that heuristic to blocks that are genuinely list items (bullets) of the enumerating structure -- a plain prose paragraph that merely mentions an id in passing must never be attributed by the same rule, or an unrelated summary paragraph gets silently absorbed into one entity's record.

A newly-created agent .md file's subagent_type is not recognized by the Agent tool's subagent roster within the same session it was authored in -- there is no mid-session reload of the harness's dispatchable-agent list. To demonstrate or exercise a brand-new agent end-to-end in the same session that created it, dispatch a general-purpose (or similar catch-all) agent with an explicit instruction to read the new agent's .md file in full and follow it as its own operating contract verbatim. This is also the documented 'Self-Execution Fallback' pattern several skills already carry for the case where the Agent tool is unavailable -- the same fallback covers the registration-timing gap.
